acts.name: Signal
acts.purpose: A dormant ancient engine recognizes an impossible transmission and chooses to answer.
acts.transitionOut: The answering observatory aperture aligns into a physical launch axis.

beats.purpose: Establish the engine as a dormant point against the dead moon observatory.
The distant beacon and local crystal routing answer one another.
The front aperture turns toward the opening chamber rather than merely reacting.

acts.name: Awakening
acts.purpose: The observatory rebuilds a path around the protagonist as dormant machinery becomes agency.
acts.transitionOut: The chamber ribs separate into a monumental corridor whose guide rails ignite outward.

beats.purpose: A restrained amber line activates inside the integrated front aperture.
The asymmetric shell turns independently from the chamber mechanism.
The engine leaves its cradle under its own controlled thrust.

acts.name: Departure
acts.purpose: The protagonist commits to a route whose scale and speed continually exceed the safety of the chamber.
acts.transitionOut: The corridor rails converge and physically lock into the nested-ring monolith.

beats.purpose: The protagonist accelerates beyond the reactivation chamber's return envelope.
Guide packets and camera lag reveal independent, intentional travel.
The gate resolves from distant light into a constructed and dangerous mechanism.

acts.name: Gates
acts.purpose: A nested-ring threshold tests anticipation, compression, recovery, and the cost of an irreversible crossing.
acts.transitionOut: The closing rings misalign the route lattice and tear open a directional fracture canyon.

beats.purpose: The outer monolith exceeds frame while leaving the protagonist readable.
Localized membrane pressure compresses the engine without turning the frame into a wash.
The lock rings close behind the recovered engine and break the old route.

acts.name: Rupture
acts.purpose: The route becomes a navigable fracture canyon; an asymmetric impact damages the engine and forces a conscious choice.
acts.transitionOut: Falling route ribs catch the damaged engine and rotate into the radial arms of a reconstruction cathedral.

beats.purpose: A deceptively stable route exposes stress lines inherited from the sealed gate.
A directional route rib strikes one armor side and extinguishes its crystal routing.
Still damaged, the engine turns toward a faint reconstruction signal instead of the open void.

acts.name: Transformation
acts.purpose: A functional reconstruction cathedral unbuilds, reroutes, and releases the protagonist as a more intentional form.
acts.transitionOut: The cathedral arms become a long parallax lattice that parts to expose Andromeda's horizon.

beats.purpose: Connected cathedral arms arrest the freefall without hiding the damaged silhouette.
Functional crystals bridge the damaged side and redirect energy through one restrained armor band.
The rebuilt engine opens its aperture and departs before the machinery withdraws.

acts.name: Arrival
acts.purpose: The transformed engine crosses a measured destination lattice and arrives before an Andromeda horizon larger than its quest.
acts.transitionOut: The camera settles only after the protagonist stops, preserving a quiet final scale relationship.

beats.purpose: A quiet lattice establishes real destination depth before the galactic reveal.
Successive markers make the protagonist visibly smaller without losing orientation.
The engine reaches a stable foreground orbit while the Andromeda horizon continues beyond frame.
